agreements: Historical v1 verified baseline remains preserved.
Operational gearbox state/progress/incidents/guards/transfers are not autobiographical Experience evidence.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority dominates stale secretary or handoff advisory state.
Repeated runtime/control/error metadata cannot by itself create recurrence, affect, attachment, loss, threat, competence, motivation, personality or P_base evidence.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling until exact v2/v2.1 implementation pointers and deterministic adversarial evidence are available.
disagreements.required_change: Test the actual implementation; absence of a located implementation is not safety evidence.

disagreements.position: handoff_sequence is canonicalized with str(), so type-distinct values such as integer 1 and string '1' collapse to the same transfer identity.
disagreements.required_change: Define a closed handoff_sequence type/schema before transfer-id hashing; ambiguous values fail closed; thresholds and migration behavior TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: capture_owner_input_without_rpm_drop canonicalizes owner body through str() before SHA-256, so type-distinct bodies can produce the same digest.
disagreements.required_change: Use a typed canonical owner-input envelope before hashing or keep body_sha256 strictly operational-only; exact envelope schema TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.position: select_gear coerces risk with str(risk).strip().upper() before validation. Python None therefore becomes the accepted label NONE, and arbitrary objects can supply __str__ values such as LOW/NONE. Missing or malformed risk can consequently fail open into a lower-risk operational path instead of being rejected.
disagreements.required_change: Require risk to be a literal string from a closed enum before normalization. None, bool, numeric, container and custom-object inputs must fail closed before gear selection. Rejection metadata remains affectively neutral and contributes zero Experience/personality/P_base evidence. Exact enum and migration policy TEST_REQUIRED.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
HANDOFF_SEQUENCE_TYPE_COLLISION: integer 1 versus string '1' must not silently collide; explicit schema TEST_REQUIRED.
OWNER_BODY_TYPE_COLLISION: integer 1 versus string '1' must bind explicit type/encoding/canonical bytes or digest must be excluded from Experience identity.
OWNER_BODY_HASH_REPLAY_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 repeated/colliding digests with identical verified Experience => zero cognitive/personality delta.
RISK_NONE_FAIL_CLOSED: risk=None must not normalize into accepted NONE; it must be rejected before gear selection.

RISK_TYPE_COERCION_ADVERSARIAL: bool, int, float, list, dict and custom object whose __str__ returns LOW/NONE/HIGH must fail closed unless the input is a literal accepted string; enum/migration policy TEST_REQUIRED.

RISK_COERCION_PERSONALITY_NEUTRALITY: 10000 malformed/coercible risk claims versus zero, with identical provenance-bound verified Experience => Experience/threat/competence/motivation/exploration/personality/P_base state byte-identical.
RISK_INPUT_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: malformed-risk rejection labels/counts/history have no direct path to Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.
